title: San Diego Prepares for El Niño and Urges Residents to Get Ready
description: SAN DIEGO – Ahead of the rainy season, City of San Diego emergency officials are urging San Diegans to take steps now to prepare for a potentially very strong El Niño climate pattern that could bring heavy rain and flooding this winter. Residents and property owners are encouraged to know their flood risk, create an emergency plan and sign up for emergency alerts to help protect themselves and their families.
